bio: Research Overview Research Background Contact Us Dr. Gazda’s laboratory studies molecular causes and pathothysiology of DBA and developed mouse models of DBA with the goal of finding the better treatment than what is currently available for DBA patients. Her laboratory closely collaborates with several researchers from Boston Children’s Hospital and international institutions. Laboratory Projects:
